goal: Define portable multi-app architecture and relational data model before code scaffolding.
constraints: Pilot on Vercel; production targets Hostinger VPS + PostgreSQL + R2.
Hermes pilot only accepts takeoff_evidence_review jobs through an isolated queue boundary.
ESTIMETR trial begins when platform membership is registered, lasts 5 days, permits 1 project and becomes read-only after expiry.
Land Acquisition V2 legacy source/schema/data is out of scope.

items.title: Create project memory, rules, commands, hooks and handoff policy
Create versioned roadmap and commit policy
Define architecture ADRs and PostgreSQL schema
Scaffold Next.js application and Drizzle migrations
Implement membership, entitlements and ESTIMETR trial/read-only policy
Implement SVG icon system and enterprise quotation intake
Draft Hermes typed job boundary and security controls
Run security audit, tag milestone and write handoff
